title: Riversport Bike Park

services.name: Whitewater Tubing
services.desc: Whether you’re looking for a bucket-list experience or a full summer of adventure sports, RIVERSPORT delivers! Now’s your chance to experience the same rapids that will be the featured venue for Olympic canoe slalom events during the LA28 Games - right here in OKC. RIVERSPORT Rapids is one of the world’s top whitewater rafting and kayaking centers and offers Class II-IV whitewater rafting in the heart of Oklahoma City. Raft with our experienced guides, then experience the rapids in a whole new way with family-style tubing. Ready to kick it up a notch? Learn to whitewater kayak down the rapids. Rafting, tubing and whitewater kayaking (for experienced paddlers) are included in your RIVERSPORT

services.name: Kayak Team
services.desc: RIVERSPORT Youth Canoe & Kayak Camps are week-long day camps in Oklahoma City that introduce campers to canoeing and kayaking while building water-safety skills and confidence on the water. Camps take place at RIVERSPORT OKC in the Boathouse District, using the Oklahoma River and whitewater facilities. Campers learn competitive kayaking skills plus water safety during this week-long day camp which includes stand-up paddle boarding, recreational kayaking, and Olympic canoe/kayak sprint and slalom - plus whitewater rafting and tubing. No previous experience is necessary. Experienced participants will have the opportunity to develop their skills. Camp participants are invited to join

services.name: Team Building
services.desc: The Boathouse District provides a memorable setting for your holiday party, wedding, business meeting or retreat. We also offer group passes for RIVERSPORT Adventures, plus picnics and other corporate events. Located on the north shore of the Oklahoma River, special event facilities in the Boathouse District offer scenic views of the river set against the backdrop of downtown Oklahoma City. The dramatic architecture of each building and expansive outdoor facilities create unique spaces for gatherings of all sizes - from intimate cocktail parties to corporate picnics. To schedule a private tour or to check date availability, please email our private event

services.name: School Groups
services.desc: Embark on an adventure with the whole class at RIVERSPORT! With exciting experiences and special pricing exclusively for school groups, RIVERSPORT offers unique opportunities to get out of the classroom and into a fun outdoor environment. Learn more about our Outdoor Classroom days, day pass discounts for schools, field trips, and team building opportunities below. Sign up your school for theOKC RIVERSPORT Youth Rowing League or have Boathouse District athletes and coaches come to your PE class or assembly. We also work with educators to create STEAM experiences in the Boathouse District and at Lake Overholser through our Cardboard Canoe

services.name: Surf OKC
services.desc: Get ready to surf - at RIVERSPORT in the Boathouse District! Grab a board and catch a wave on Surf OKC presented by TSET. With endless waves and a trampoline-like surface, this experience is perfect for all skill levels. No previous experience needed; you can take a lesson (see below) or just show up and give it a shot. Our surf staff can teach you all the basics. You start by bodyboarding, then go for the full flowboarding experience. If you’re a wakeboarder, skateboarder or snowboarder, you’ll be surfing in no time. Surf’s up! Join us for exclusive members-only hangtime on Surf OKC from 5-6p on Thursdays during the 2025 summer season. See excluded dates below. Discover Surfing lessons

services.name: Climbing Walls
services.desc: RIVERSPORT climbing walls let you reach for the sky with options that include a 30 ft. four-sided outdoor climbing wall, a youth climbing wall, and the covered Nordic Adventures climbing walls featuring a cavern wall, leap of faith, adventure climb, and speed wall. Please note - all adventures require secure footwear; no Crocs, flip-flops or sandals without a back strap are allowed. You’ll find more important information here to ensure you have a great RIVERSPORT Adventure! Weight requirement: 40 lbs. minimum, 300 lbs. maximum. services.name: Love’s Tubing
services.desc: Experience RIVERSPORT Rapids in a whole new way - tube down the rapids for a splashing good time. It’s fun and so easy, kids and adults alike enjoy the experience. Like our other adventures, we provide everything you’ll need including the tube and PFD (life jacket). Love’s Tubing is open daily with select hours on Saturdays during the summer. It’s a great way to get wet this summer and with your season membership you can come every day. Please note - secure footwear is required for all activities. No slides, flip flops or Crocs are allowed. You’ll find more important information here to ensure you have a great RIVERSPORT
